newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Compared to Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were not well established with few sales steady, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand light to moderate. Seller interest light early, then moderate. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1225-1275 lbs few 68.50 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.

Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Tuesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 112.00 few Choice early 113.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 104.00-105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 107.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 101.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs 112.00.
